content: E2E libs (npm + READMEs, 2026-11-27): age-encryption 0.3.1 (typage, FiloSottile) implements the age file format in TypeScript on noble libs, uses WebCrypto when available, supports X25519 and post-quantum hybrid recipients, multiple recipients, passphrases, ReadableStream encryption, WebAuthn PRF passkey encryption; ES2023, Node 20+/Bun/Deno/browsers. @noble/ciphers|curves|hashes 2.4.0 pure JS (v1 line Cure53-audited 2024; curves audited by Trail of Bits Aug 2026; v2 self-audited). @hpke/core 1.10.1 = RFC 9180 HPKE on WebCrypto only. libsodium-wrappers 0.8.4 is WASM (MV3 needs wasm-unsafe-eval CSP). WebCrypto X25519/Ed25519 ship in Blink, WebKit, Gecko.
